name: Anna Sara Schuch

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Johann Christoffel Doll; she is 'Sara, Joh. Peter Schuchen Tochter'

bioAdditions: Her marriage entry of 2 Mar 1704 at Ulmet calls her Sara, daughter of Joh. Peter Schuch (S1). FamilySearch calls her Sara Margaretha Schuch, born at Rathsweiler on 11 Jan 1686 (baptized 28 Mar), daughter of Hans Peter Schuch (1661-1747) and Anna Maria Käppel (S2). It also has her emigrating: she died at Tohickon, Bucks Co., Pennsylvania, on 3 Apr 1760 and was buried at Bedminster. The source for that is a Historical Society of Pennsylvania burial card for 'Sarah Doll', whose image came back empty (S2). If correct, she came over with her son Caspar's group in 1739, and women were not listed on those ships. She would then have lived near the Tohickon Reformed congregation, where Caspar's daughter Anna Catharina was baptized in 1757. The site's 'Anna Sara' should probably be 'Sara (Margaretha)'.

relationships.evidence: 1704 marriage names her father Joh. Peter Schuch

conflicts.foundValue: Sara (1704 marriage; 1722 baptism 'Anna Sara'); Sara Margaretha (FamilySearch)
